name: resistance band spider crawls
description: A wall-based spider crawl with a resistance band around the wrists. Walking the hands up and down the wall challenges the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Loop a light resistance band around your wrists and stand facing a wall.
Place both hands on the wall around chest height, keeping gentle outward tension on the band.
Walk your hands up the wall in small alternating steps, then walk them back down without letting the shoulders shrug.
Keep your trunk steady and repeat for the desired number of rounds.
